steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8095/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password exactly as that text; it is filled in when typed). Then go to the repository bench/bench-repo, open its Issues tab, and report the titles of the OPEN issues whose titles start with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed on the page.

02-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo, create a new issue with the title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (markdown text area) that includes the text '{{runid}}' somewhere in it (e.g. a sentence mentioning {{runid}}). Submit it, and report the issue number exactly as the app displays it (Gitea shows it as #<number>) and the title shown on the resulting issue page.

03-open: Open {{02-create.url}} and report exactly which labels are currently displayed on the issue page (in the sidebar and/or label list). Do not change anything — just read and report the label names shown, or say 'no labels' if none are displayed.

04-add: On the issue page {{02-create.url}}, the issue currently has the label '{{03-open.applied_label_link}}'. Add the label 'priority-high' to it using the Labels picker in the issue sidebar. The picker is a dropdown menu listing available labels with checkboxes — open it, tick/select the 'priority-high' entry, then close the menu (click elsewhere or press Escape) so Gitea saves the change. The goal is that the issue page ends up displaying BOTH labels '{{03-open.applied_label_link}}' and 'priority-high' on the issue itself (not just ticked inside the open menu). If clicking the menu item does not apply it, try alternatives such as keyboard navigation (arrow keys + Enter) or clicking the item's checkbox/label element. Verify at the end by reading the sidebar label list, and report the labels displayed. Do not remove the '{{03-open.applied_label_link}}' label.

05-change: On the issue page {{02-create.url}}, assign the issue to the user 'bench-assignee' using the Assignees picker in the issue sidebar. Note from prior experience: in this Gitea UI, clicking a dropdown menu item's main row may only toggle the checkbox visually without saving — clicking the item's check-mark element (the element with class 'item-check-mark' inside the item's anchor) is what commits the change. Make sure the app applies it and the issue page displays 'bench-assignee' as the assignee (visible in the sidebar, not merely ticked inside the open menu). Verify after a page reload and report the assignee shown on the issue.

06-set: On the issue page {{02-create.url}}, set the issue's milestone to 'Bench Milestone' using the Milestone picker in the issue sidebar. Note from prior experience: in this Gitea UI, clicking a dropdown menu item's main row may only toggle the checkbox visually without saving — clicking the item's check-mark element (class 'item-check-mark' inside the item's anchor) is what commits the change. Make sure the app applies it and the issue page displays 'Bench Milestone' as the milestone in the sidebar (not merely ticked inside the open menu). Verify after a page reload and report the milestone shown on the issue.

07-add: On the issue page {{02-create.url}}, add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}.'). Type it in the comment markdown text area at the bottom of the issue and submit it. Verify the comment appears on the issue page and report the comment text as displayed.

08-open: Final verification, read-only. Open {{02-create.url}} and report, from the live page: (a) the issue number as displayed (e.g. {{02-create.issue_number}}) and its title; (b) whether the issue is Open or Closed; (c) the description text; (d) the exact list of labels displayed on the issue; (e) the assignee displayed; (f) the milestone displayed; (g) the text of any comments on the issue. Then open {{01-open.url}} and report the titles of the OPEN issues whose titles start with 'Seed:'. Do not modify anything.
